fact: Iscte and Uni-CV began project ORAL (15 months from 15 October 2025, USD 72,000, co-funded by OEI) to release open-access Kriolu corpora, the first Kriolu LLM, translation and speech recognition models and public APIs on Hugging Face.
title: Iscte lança projeto internacional para o desenvolvimento de modelos de linguagem em crioulo cabo-verdiano
